name: 24x100
description: What a Pittsburgh lot can hold, what's holding it back, and what would move it.

scripts.build:data: tsx scripts/build-city.ts && tsx scripts/build-summary.ts && tsx scripts/build-scenarios.ts && tsx scripts/build-api.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:data && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.rebuild: uv run python -m pipeline all && npm run seed:rules && npm run build
scripts.refresh: uv run python -m pipeline refresh && npm run build:data
